أتكافح (form VI)
# أَتَكَافَحُ (ʔatakāfaḥu) /ʔa.ta.kaː.fa.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
# أَتَكَافَحَ (ʔatakāfaḥa) /ʔa.ta.kaː.fa.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
# أَتَكَافَحْ (ʔatakāfaḥ) /ʔa.ta.kaː.faħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
